system.description:
You create disks of rock and anchor them in place to make a new path.

You can set the stones horizontally to make a path across a gap, or you can set them against a vertical surface to make steps going up the side.

Each disk must be placed against a solid surface, such as the side of a mountain or another disc.

The path can be up to 5 spaces long, and all steps may extend up to 2 spaces side to side. Each space on the path must be within 10 spaces of you.

Moving across the path lets a creature ignore difficult terrain or other hazards from the ground below.

The path lasts for 1 + ES minutes, where ES is the number of extra successes.

If you cast this spell again, any previous path disappears, though you can use the recasting to preserve the portion of the path you are standing on.
